page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head at the top and the page number at the top left. No marginal notes. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Alfonsus in canone ærarum numerat inter Alexan-drum & æra Arabū 340700 dies, quatenus æra Ara-bum feria quinta incipit: Saracenus autem ponit in-teruallum 340701 dierum, quatenus æra Arabū in-choatur feria sexta. Albumafar ait, inter duo cornua habentem, id eft, Alexandrum Dhilkanain, & primū annum Alhegiræ, intercessisse annos Romanos 932, & 287 dies, qui efficiunt annos Ægyptios 933, & 155 dies, hoc eft, in vniuersum 340700 dies: atq; sic cum Alfonso conuenit. Cum autem in exeplari Albumafaris subnectitur, annos Romanos 932 & 287 dies, conficere annos Arabicos 974 & 294 dies. mendum eft: faciunt enim annos Arabicos 961, & 154 dies, sicut ex Arabico calendario discere potes. Alfraganus nofter asserit inter Alexandru & æra Persicam intercedere annos Romanos nongetos quadraginta duos, & dies ducentos quinquaginta noue, hoc eft, dies in vniuersu 344324 à quibus si subtrahatur radix Persica, quæ eft 230639 dierū, remanent 1 1368 dies: quod eft interuallū inter Alexandru & æra Christi. Adhæc Albumafar scribit, inter Philippum, hoc eft, mortem Alexandri & Iezdagird intercessisse 955 annos Ægyptios, & 90 dies: licet in exeplari edito male legatur 950 annos. Idem Alfraganus nofter testatur, quod etiā annotatum eft in traslatione antiqua Almagesti, sub finem libri tertii. Atqui à Philippo, hoc eft, ab æra mortis Alexandri vsq; ad Alexandru Dhilkarnain, siue æram Alexandrinā Seleucidarū, intercesserunt 4341 dies, hoc eft, anni Ægyptij vndecim, & 326 dies: qui si subtrahatur ab annis Ægyptiis 955, & 9 odiebus: remanet anni Ægyptii 943, & 129 dies, h.e. anni Romani 942, & 359 dies: vt ex resolutione appa-ret: atq; hoc interuallū est inter Alexandru & mortē lezdaje-

page.notes: Several figures and letters in the small type are uncertain, especially the numbers 340700, 340701, 344324, 230639 and 1 1368, and the words Arabu, primu and subtrahatur. The page is also set in a text face that makes the long s and the f hard to tell apart in places; I have read them as plain s where the sense requires it. The word "lezdagird" in the catchword and the line below is printed with a hyphen at the line end as "lezdaje-". The catchword "lezdaje-" is kept with its printed hyphen.
